title: Hina plans a trip to Italy

scenes.caption: A map.
scenes.say: Hina looks at a map of Europe in her home in Manchester.

scenes.caption: Italy.
scenes.say: Her family wants to visit northern Italy. Rome is the capital.

scenes.caption: The Alps.
scenes.say: On the way, they will cross the Alps.

scenes.caption: Scotland.
scenes.say: Scotland is wet because Atlantic winds bring a lot of rain.

scenes.caption: Italy's climate.
scenes.say: Italy has a Mediterranean climate with hot, dry summers.

scenes.caption: Packing.
scenes.say: She packs light clothes, a sun hat and walking shoes.

scenes.caption: Respect.
scenes.say: She plans to respect local customs and keep places clean.

scenes.caption: A postcard.
scenes.say: Hina writes a postcard home about Europe's many landscapes.
